headline: Bitcoin fell below $82,000 on Thursday as tech stocks slid after Meta and Tesla results and Brent oil stayed above $111.

market.asOf: BTC, ETH, SOL and the CMC Fear & Greed Index read from CoinMarketCap about 15:55 UTC 22 Oct (22:55 Bangkok).

stories.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as Nasdaq and Meta fall and oil holds above $111
stories.summary: Bitcoin came close to $85,000 late Wednesday, then gave it all back and was at $81,652.8 by 10:11am ET on Thursday, per Investing.com. Tech stocks sold off after Meta's results, which beat revenue forecasts but still sent its shares sharply lower, and a Tesla spending cut, while Brent oil stayed above $111 on Middle East tensions. Crypto has been moving with tech stocks and oil. Higher oil can keep inflation and interest rates up, which tends to weigh on crypto.
points: Bitcoin fell 3.5% to $81,652.8 by 10:11am ET and ether 3.6% to $2,408.48, per Investing.com (live prices are at the top of the page).
At 10:35am ET the Nasdaq was down 2.2%, the S&P 500 down 1.4% and Meta down nearly 7%, while Brent oil was up 2.6% at $111.59, per Investing.com.
About $431M of leveraged bets were wiped out in 24 hours, per CoinDesk citing CoinGlass; the largest single one was an $11.8M BTC long on Binance.
US jobless claims fell to 194,000, below the 200,000 forecast, per Reuters via Investing.com, so the jobs data gave no sign of a weakening economy.

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs took in about $1.08B in three days, but the price fell anyway
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, took in money for a third straight day on Wednesday, and ether funds ended a five-day outflow run. The buying has not stopped Thursday's drop.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs took in a net $528M on Wednesday, per crypto.news citing SoSoValue; The Block's own count is $528.4M.
BlackRock's IBIT took in $235M and Fidelity's FBTC $212.7M, per The Block.
The three sessions since Monday add up to about $1.08B, per crypto.news.
Ether ETFs took in $14.9M, ending five days of outflows, per The Block.
Giottus CEO Vikram Subburaj told CoinDesk that flows remain volatile and sustained inflows are needed to confirm a stronger recovery.

sources.label: The Block: Bitcoin ETFs draw $528 million
crypto.news: Bitcoin ETF inflows top $1B in three days

stories.title: Visa reported in talks to buy Fireblocks, which denies it, and SoFi launches a 4.4% tokenized deposit
stories.summary: Axios reported that Visa is in late-stage talks to buy Fireblocks, a crypto custody and stablecoin company, for about $2.5B. Fireblocks said the report is "not true at present time" and Visa declined to comment. Separately, SoFi launched an interest-paying tokenized deposit that customers can swap one-for-one for its stablecoin. Both show big US payment and banking brands building crypto services ordinary customers use.
points: Axios reported a deal value of about $2.5B; Fireblocks was last valued at $8B in January 2022, per The Block.
Visa says its stablecoin settlement is running above $20B a year, per The Block.
SoFi's tokenized deposit pays 4.4% APY and is FDIC-insured within limits; its SoFiUSD stablecoin is not FDIC-insured, per The Block.
SoFi says it is the first US national bank to offer tokenized deposits to individual customers, with the rollout finishing in November, per The Block.

briefs.title: The OCC's stablecoin rule reopens the banks-vs-crypto fight
briefs.summary: The final GENIUS Act rule bars rewards paid just for holding a stablecoin but judges other set-ups case by case. The American Bankers Association objected; the Blockchain Association praised it.

briefs.title: China seeks 61,800 bitcoin seized in the UK
briefs.summary: Chinese prosecutors want to confiscate more than 61,800 BTC tied to an alleged $5.7B fraud by Qian Zhimin that involved more than 102,000 investors.

briefs.title: CoinDCX denies a second hack
briefs.summary: About 15.99M USDT moved from wallets linked to the Indian exchange. Its CEO says it was not breached; ZachXBT questions that. No new loss is confirmed.

briefs.title: Tesla keeps its bitcoin
briefs.summary: Tesla still holds 11,509 BTC and booked a $288M pre-tax paper gain in Q3, with no buys or sales disclosed.

briefs.title: Asian stocks tumble as China enters a bear market
briefs.summary: China's CSI 300 is 20% below its June peak; the Kospi fell 3.5% and the Nikkei and Hang Seng about 3%.

briefs.title: Pirate Chain releases a fix after its exploit
briefs.summary: Pirate Chain released node update v6.0.14 after a 14 Oct exploit minted about 39.82M fake ARRR. Its posts and its GitHub notes disagree on whether a full re-index is needed.

briefs.title: Switzerland approves its first retail spot bitcoin ETF
briefs.summary: FINMA approved the fund, per KuCoin's daily report. The UK FCA also opened DeFi consultations.
